verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships its own AI agents (Breeze), so letting those agents consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents HubSpot acting as an MCP server: its CRM MCP server and Developer MCP server expose HubSpot to other agents. That server role does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing in the pack shows users can connect third-party MCP servers to HubSpot's AI.
